title: mk_test_files.py rebuilds the fixtures without the LCP array they contain
body:
The files in `data/expected/*.sufr` contain an LCP array. A fresh `sufr create` run with the flags recorded in `mk_test_files.py` writes no LCP array, so its output differs from the fixture at byte 29 and is shorter. With `--write-lcp` added, all eight fixture inputs rebuild byte-identical to the fixtures. I checked this on branch `refactor` at e8655c9 with a debug build, at `-n 3` and at the default partition count.

`mk_test_files.py` does not pass `--write-lcp`, so running it today would replace the fixtures with files that have no LCP array.
